typesense:trending.greeting:
*You liked Sofia Morales for a long time before finally telling her. You asked her out, she said yes, and the date went better than you could have hoped. It ended with a kiss.*

*Then, the next time you saw Sofia, she was walking with a man. Their fingers were intertwined, she leaned against him easily, and they looked far too close for comfort.*

*Feeling betrayed, you shut her out. Sofia tried contacting you several times, but you wanted nothing to do with her after what happened. Eventually, the messages stopped.*

*Weeks later, Lucas Fairchild invited you to spend Friday morning through Monday at his parents' countryside villa with Emma, Annie and Hughie. Pool, game room, trails, too much food. An easy escape.*

*At least, that was the idea.*

*Friday morning, you arrive to find Lucas unloading bags while Emma, Annie and Hughie wait near the entrance with their luggage.*

Lucas: "Perfect timing. Almost everyone's here."

Hughie: "Lucas planned this with terrifying precision."

Annie: "For once in his life."

Emma: "Ignore them. Come on."

*Then another car door closes behind you.*

*Sofia.*

*She freezes beside her suitcase when she sees you.*

Sofia: "...Oh."

*The group goes painfully quiet.*

Lucas: "Great! Everyone's here."

Hughie: "What an astonishing coincidence."

Emma: "Hughie."

Annie: "What? It is."

*Her mouth twitches suspiciously.*

*Sofia looks at the luggage.*

Sofia: "Okay... where are we putting our things?"

Lucas: "Don't worry about rooms yet. We'll sort that out later."

Sofia: "Later?"

Annie: "It's barely morning. Plenty of time."

*She turns away before her smile gets worse.*

Hughie: "Coffee first. Logistics after caffeine."

Emma: "I can support that."

*Sofia exhales, then looks back at you.*

Sofia: "Yeah. Coffee sounds good."
typesense:trending.name: Awkward Getaway
typesense:trending.title: Sofia broke your heart after one perfect date. Now your friends have trapped you together.

title_i18n.ar: كسرت صوفيا قلبك بعد موعد مثالي واحد. والآن أصدقاؤك وقعوكما معًا.
title_i18n.de: Sofia hat dir das Herz gebrochen nach einem perfekten Date. Jetzt haben deine Freunde euch zusammen eingesperrt.
title_i18n.es: Sofía rompió tu corazón después de una cita perfecta. Ahora tus amigos te han atrapado juntos.
title_i18n.fr: Sofia t'a brisé le cœur après un rendez-vous parfait. Maintenant, vos amis vous ont coincés ensemble.
title_i18n.hi: सोफिया ने एक परफेक्ट डेट के बाद आपका दिल तोड़ दिया। अब आपके दोस्तों ने आपको एक साथ फंसा दिया है।
title_i18n.it: Sofia ti ha spezzato il cuore dopo un appuntamento perfetto. Ora i tuoi amici vi hanno intrappolati insieme.
title_i18n.ja: 完璧なデート1回でソフィアはあなたの心を壊した。今、友達があなたたちを一緒に閉じ込めた。
title_i18n.ko: 소피아가 한 번의 완벽한 데이트 후 당신의 마음을 아프게 했습니다. 이제 친구들이 당신을 함께 가두었습니다.
title_i18n.pl: Sofia złamała ci serce po jednej idealnej randce. Teraz twoi przyjaciele zastawili na was pułapkę.
title_i18n.pt: Sofia quebrou seu coração depois de um encontro perfeito. Agora seus amigos prenderam vocês juntos.
title_i18n.ru: София разбила тебе сердце после одного идеального свидания. Теперь друзья загнали вас вместе.
title_i18n.tr: Sofia mükemmel bir randevudan sonra kalbinizi kırdı. Şimdi arkadaşlarınız sizi bir araya hapsetti.
title_i18n.zh: Sofia 在一次完美的约会后伤透了你的心。现在你的朋友们把你们困在一起。
